on smaller render I suggest increasing the steps for better quality less fuziness.
IMPORTANT: keep the audio of the first pass in the audio output of the second pass, the second pass destroys the audio
ALSO if you make vidoe with lyp synch stay under 0.3 denoise

# MarkDKBerry.com

YouTube: [https://www.youtube.com/@markdkberry](https://www.youtube.com/@markdkberry)

Patreon: [https://www.patreon.com/c/AIMakingMovies](https://www.patreon.com/c/AIMakingMovies)

---

This was taken from a workflow by "sftawil" on Discord, and adapted here.

It works on the basis of first pass for structure at half size you want to end up at, upscale in pixel space between the samplers, then less steps and low denoise for 2nd sampler at around 1920 x 1080 (or whatever works for you without oom).

This method was used to good effect with WAN dual models in latent space originally, but currently we have to go to pixel space between samplers as there isnt a H3 latent space upscaler that does a good job.

---

Settings will need to be changed to suit your model and loras. and size you can go to will depend upon your GPU

## On a 3060 RTX 12GB VRAM with 32 gb system ram

**5 second video starting at 1280 x 512 (2.50:1 aspect ratio) 8 step lightx2v lora in first pass. Upscaled x1.5 and 3 steps through 2nd pass takes about 35 mins.**

It isnt perfect but its closest I have got to good final results at that size. USDU with HuMO is a close second but it takes another 35 mins to complete at 1920 x 768 x 5 seconds.

## LIMITS (on my 3060 RTX)

**8 seconds starting at 1280 x 512 oomed at 1280 x 512** after saving the "preview" video of the 1st sampler. You can then load that video up and finish it off through the 2nd sampler with cleared VRAM and same seed, does work but its not ideal long-term.

**1120 x 448 x 8 secs with 1.5 multiple in the NVIDIA upscaler using int8 model finished without oom**. Took 42 mins. Result was good enough.

**I was able to do 1280 x 512 x 8 seconds using the w4a8 model** though and it finished in 55 mins. I dont know if it was better than the 1120 x 448 x 8 seconds version, they were close contenders so needs more test. but it didn't oom.

## THINGS TO TRY IF YOU OOM

Oom is the issue, otherwise using H3 model for upscaling would be the solution. Some things to try which I havent yet tested but might bring VRAM use down and push resolution up

- w4a8 model (I was using int8 pruned for quality, w4a8 will take same time but use slightly less VRAM at cost of quality but offers increased resolution so might work)
- set ref images to match not max (I was using max in tests above)
- finding a way to properly clear the VRAM fully between samplers after the upscaler (I used my usual methods but it left something in the VRAM).
- 3 sampler solution might work even better at lower resolution. untested.

1824 x 768 (1.4 mp)
1760 x 744 (1.31 MP)
1680 x 720 (1.21 MP) - 23 mins for 8 sec vid.
1280 x 576 (0.7 mp)
1216 x 512 (0.6 mp)
960 x 448 (0.4 mp) (1st pass, 2nd ends in 1920 x 896)

---

## 2.50:1 aspect ratio

or 2.50:1 equivalent (I was using with LTX for widescreen in "Black Magic" musical scenes. Its also faster than 16:9.)

1920 × 768 (1.47 MP)
1824 × 736 (1.34 MP) - 26 to 30 mins for 8 sec video.
1760 × 704 (1.24 MP recommended)
1600 × 640 (1mp)
1440 × 576 pixels (0.83mp)
1280 x 512 (0.66 mp) - ideal but mine ooms if done in one go
1120 x 448 (0.50 mp)
866 x 346 (0.3mp)
640 x 256 = (0.16mp) - test resolution 150 seconds.

<Subject 1> is the blonde woman whose appearance comes from <Picture 2>, hair pulled back, wearing an open light-blue denim jacket over a black cropped top, high-waisted distressed denim shorts, a small gold cross necklace, and white sneakers, matching her position standing near the stage-left wing in <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is the ballerina whose appearance comes from <Picture 3>, dark hair pulled back, wearing a flowing light-grey chiffon dress with a V-neck wrap bodice and a sheer billowing skirt, sheer pink tights, and pink pointe shoes, matching her position on pointe at the right side of the stage in <Picture 1>.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] The target video begins from <Picture 1>, a grand red-and-gold theatre with <Subject 2> poised on pointe at the right of the stage and <Subject 1> standing still near the left wing. <Subject 2> runs on pointe from right to left across the stage directly to <Subject 1>, stops beside her, leans in and kisses her on the cheek, then turns and continues offstage through the stage-left exit, while <Subject 1> remains motionless, watching her the whole time. The camera slowly dollies in toward the two figures as the action unfolds.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - the theatre's red velvet seating, gilded proscenium, balcony, stage lighting rig, and the starting positions of both women are retained.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the denim jacket, black crop top, distressed denim shorts, necklace, and white sneakers are retained, and she remains stationary near the stage-left wing throughout.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the light-grey chiffon dress, sheer billowing skirt, pink tights, and pointe shoes are retained as she runs to, pauses beside, and then leaves <Subject 1>.

detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic, theatrical style with warm golden stage lighting against the deep red velvet of an ornate opera house, rendered with a soft, romantic focus.
[Shot 1] the shot begins from <Picture 1>, a wide establishing view of the theatre from the orchestra seats: tiered red velvet chairs in the foreground, a gilded balcony ringing the walls, dark stage curtains framed by ornate gold trim, and warm amber stage lights glowing above house left. On the black stage floor, <Subject 2>, the ballerina in the flowing light-grey chiffon dress with sheer billowing skirt, stands balanced on pointe near the right side of the stage, both arms raised as she holds the edges of her skirt outstretched. Near the left side of the stage, close to the wing entrance, <Subject 1>, the blonde woman in the open denim jacket, black cropped top, and distressed denim shorts, stands still, facing toward the stage. <Subject 2> lowers out of her pose and breaks into a swift run on pointe, moving directly from right to left across the stage floor toward <Subject 1>, her chiffon skirt billowing and streaming behind her with each stride. As she reaches <Subject 1>, she slows and comes to a stop right beside her, turning to face her. <Subject 2> leans in and presses a gentle kiss to <Subject 1>'s cheek. <Subject 1> remains completely still through the approach and the kiss, her stance unchanged, her eyes following the ballerina the entire time. <Subject 2> then pulls back, turns, and breaks into a run again, continuing leftward past the wing light stand and disappearing offstage through the exit, her pale dress vanishing into the shadow of the curtain. Throughout the shot, the camera performs a slow, steady dolly-in from its wide establishing position toward the two figures, gradually tightening the frame around them as the kiss happens, and settling on <Subject 1> alone near the wing as the ballerina exits.

overall_soundscape:
The quick, light patter of pointe shoes running across the wooden stage floor continues throughout the shot, briefly pausing during the moment of the kiss, layered with the faint hush of an empty theatre and a low, distant hum from the stage lighting rig.

non_diegetic_music:
A gentle, slow solo-piano and string underscore swells softly beneath the shot, rising slightly at the kiss and settling into a wistful close as the ballerina exits.
